name: emit-edges-unbound-naming-limits
body: EdgeEmitter.EmitEdges names an unbound call or type by the raw syntax text, so a reference split across lines keeps its inner whitespace and newlines in the target name. An unbound implicit var emits no use of its inferred type. A bound qualified generic type use such as System.Collections.Generic.List<Bar> emits its unresolved_use twice, once from the qualified name and once from its right-hand part, because outermost-name absorption applies only to unbound types. Upgrade by normalising the as-written name, and by absorbing bound qualified-name fragments, when exact per-edge counts or single-line names matter.
